native_context: Password verifier storage, migration and resource policy
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: Password verifier storage, migration and resource policy — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace enroll/verify/reset/rehash to the actual library and stored verifier parameters/version. Record salts, pepper boundary, input-length/Unicode handling and legacy migration.
controls.controlled_verification: Use nonsecret fixture passwords and verifiers. Compare correct/incorrect verification and a successful legacy rehash, measuring only a bounded local sample under the intended resource budget. Inspect what happens when configured parameters or input exceed supported limits.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A hash-looking string is not proof of a password KDF or adequate work factor. A recommendation mismatch alone does not establish an online compromise. Never collect production password hashes or crack passwords for this review.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported current password-verifier configuration and safe migration after successful verification. Retest valid/invalid passwords, rehash and declared input/resource limits.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
